bugs.title: The link to Pricing resulted in a 404 error and navigation to a non-existent page.
bugs.evidence:
url        : / -> /pricing.html
  title      : 'Widget Co — Home' -> '404 Not Found'
  page text  : 404 Not Found | 404 Not Found | The requested URL was not found
  console    : Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)
  http errors: 404 /pricing.html
bugs.observed: Clicking 'Pricing' led to a 404 error, navigating to an undefined URL.
bugs.expected: Clicking 'Pricing' should navigate to /pricing.html without errors.
bugs.discrepancy: The link to Pricing resulted in a 404 error and navigation to a non-existent page.

bugs.title: A network request or page re-render is expected when typing, but none occurred.
bugs.evidence: effect     : NO OBSERVABLE CHANGE — the page is byte-identical after this action
bugs.observed: Typing a single character into the 'message' field caused no change.
bugs.expected: Typing should update the field value.
bugs.discrepancy: A network request or page re-render is expected when typing, but none occurred.

bugs.title: A control that promises to export something did nothing and caused a console error.
bugs.evidence: console    : Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'run')
bugs.observed: Clicking 'Export catalog' produced no change, no navigation, and a console error.
bugs.expected: 'Export catalog' should trigger an export process or request.
bugs.discrepancy: A control that promises to export something did nothing and caused a console error.

bugs.title: Repeated rapid clicks resulted in multiple uncaught console errors without any observable effect on the page.
bugs.evidence: console    : Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'run') | Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'run') | Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'run') | Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'run') | Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'run')
bugs.observed: Rapid clicking on 'Export catalog' produced multiple console errors but no change in the UI.
bugs.expected: Clicking a control that promises to export something should either work or provide feedback, even if it fails.
bugs.discrepancy: Repeated rapid clicks resulted in multiple uncaught console errors without any observable effect on the page.

bugs.title: The form fields (message and name) were cleared instead of being initialized with existing values.
bugs.evidence: form state : message: absent -> empty; name: absent -> empty
bugs.observed: Clicking 'Contact' navigated to /contact.html, updated the title, and cleared form fields.
bugs.expected: Navigating to a contact page should preserve or initialize form fields appropriately.
bugs.discrepancy: The form fields (message and name) were cleared instead of being initialized with existing values.

bugs.title: The page did not change as expected, suggesting a navigation issue.
bugs.observed: BROWSING BACK from /catalog.html to / refreshed the title and page text.
bugs.expected: Navigating back should restore the previous state of the page.
bugs.discrepancy: The page did not change as expected, suggesting a navigation issue.

bugs.title: The navigation back to the home page did not update the content, showing a stale version.
bugs.evidence:
url        : /pricing.html -> /
  title      : '404 Not Found' -> 'Widget Co — Home'
  page text  : Widget Co — Home | Widget Co | Catalog | Contact | Pricing | Everything you need, in one place.
bugs.observed: Browser back from 404 page navigated to home but did not re-fetch the content.
bugs.expected: Navigating back should restore the previous state without re-fetching.
bugs.discrepancy: The navigation back to the home page did not update the content, showing a stale version.

bugs.title: The back action caused a full navigation, which is unexpected for such a simple operation.
bugs.observed: Scrolling and back navigation changed the URL to / and updated the title and page text.
bugs.expected: Back should revert to the previous state without requiring a scroll.
bugs.discrepancy: The back action caused a full navigation, which is unexpected for such a simple operation.
